name: Adventuring Gear — landfall boost is not a static bonus
notes: Memory: project_adventuring_gear_equip_trigger_2026-05-28 (Bug 1). The runtime-gained-Equipment scanner matched the 'Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, equipped creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn' line as a static boost, so an equipped creature was permanently 4/4. Grizzly Bears equipped with Adventuring Gear must stay 2/2 until the trigger is fired.
